notes.title: Magellania UI Patch
notes.content:
This patch brings some of the UI changes I made to Juno 06 over to Magellania, which should allow for a less scuffed game overall.
[list]
[*]Changed various UI components to be more readable and consistent
[*]Fixed some bugs that happened with empty party sizes
[*]Fixed some error messages that people were getting when loading in
[*]Fixed a bug that prevented random battles from spawning after a certain point in the game
[*]Changed Lofty's character art
[/list]

notes.title: Small Patch, and the Future of Magellania
notes.content:
Changes:
[list]
[*]Adjusted Lofty's character art.
[*]Changed the cover art.
[*]Lowered the volume of one particular music track.
[/list]

Hello all, this month Juno 06 received a patch that changed a lot of things about the game. It added achievements and grid-based movement. You can read about it [url=https://open.substack.com/pub/illun/p/juno-06-update-dec-2024?r=46mtlh&utm_campaign=post&utm_medium=web&showWelcomeOnShare=true]here[/url]. 

This naturally raises the question: will Magellania receive an overhaul?

I think some of the changes I made to Juno 06 will eventually make their way over to Magellania, but they will not be as extensive. While Magellania is special for being the first thing I released, it's been a long time since I worked on it, and I wanted to differentiate Juno 06 from Magellania since it is supposed to be the sequel. In a way, it makes sense for Magellania to be the way it is, since it can represent the mindset I had about a lot of things when I started out. I hope that when people play my much later games, they can see a difference between those games and this game.

However, I will see what can be done, and what my time permits.

Anyway, stay tuned for more progress on Game 3 in the future. Thank you for supporting my game development. And finally, Merry Christmas to you all.

notes.title: Patch
notes.content: The amount of units you can recruit from a certain (very broken) class has been limited to 1 only, for balancing reasons. This is a bit experimental at the moment. In the future, I might add it back in, especially if I have to differentiate between standard mode and hard mode, but this is how it will be for now. If you have a save file with multiple units of this class, you will be able to keep them, but you won't be able to recruit more.

notes.title: Patch

This patch makes some balancing changes:

-Stretched all UI portraits by 105% horizontally
-Made small changes to Stanley's UI portrait sprites

If you don't like the changes made to stats, the previous build of the game has been archived. To access this branch of the game, right-click Magellania from your library list on the left. >properties >betas

Under the list of betas you can opt into, select "archived - Archived Build".

-Difficulty of mid-lategame maps have been increased slightly
-Gave Lofty's sprite a "facing away" direction for gameplay clarity
-Changed the way the UI dialogue portrait resizes at certain resolutions
-Changed the starting logo to from "Studio Land" to "Illunsoft"
-Made various changes to dialogue
-Fixed a certain bug regarding unit stats remaining on the bottom-left of the screen even after a stage has been completed
-Fixed a certain bug that affected how combos accumulated in the postgame

notes.title: Another Patch
notes.content:
This patch contains some bug fixes, QoL changes, and some visual updates that I have made to the new game I am working on. Those changes are trickling back to this game.

-Removed a bug that caused the text parsing sound to clip sometimes
-Fixed a bug that caused preview damage calculation to calculate incorrectly for the following badges: Ranged Shield, Melee Shield
-Fixed a bug that prevented the cursor from scrolling the screen correctly while at the edge of the map
-Fixed a bug that allowed the player to recruit Clerics with 2x Atk
-Bards will no longer allow the War Demon badge to activate again during the same phase
-After activating War Demon, the unit will automatically be reselected now
-An additional decorative UI element has been added to the dialogue box

notes.title: Hotfix 2
notes.content: Hello, even after the first patch today, some users are still having issues with launching the game. I have implemented a second patch that should fix things. However, *if your game is still not able to launch, you can likely fix the issue by going into the local files and running "redist001.exe" from the game folder and restarting your computer*. If this doesn't work, there are some other suggested solutions pinned in the steam support thread.

tags.bug: I have implemented a second patch that should fix things.

notes.title: Release Hotfix
notes.content: Some users who installed Magellania immediately after release were having trouble launching the game. If you are currently having issues of a similar nature, try uninstalling and reinstalling the game as I have implemented a solution that should've taken care of that. If issues of a different nature persist, we have a support thread for that kind of thing.
